description: This file is a shell script for rewriting git revision history, including functions for commit filtering, remapping commits, and updating references. It is part of a git filtering tool, specifically 'git-filter-branch'.

methods.name: warn
methods.description: Outputs a warning message to standard error.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Maps a commit or object ID to its rewritten counterpart, or returns the original if not rewritten.

methods.name: skip_commit
methods.description: Skips a commit in the filtering process, mapping its parents.

methods.name: git_commit_non_empty_tree
methods.description: Creates a commit with a non-empty tree, or reuses existing if unchanged.

methods.name: die
methods.description: Outputs an error message and exits the script.

methods.name: finish_ident
methods.description: Ensures commit author/committer identities are set and exported.

methods.name: set_ident
methods.description: Parses author and committer identities from a commit and finishes setting them.
